<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>The Ashtead Group Long-Term Incentive Plan 2021 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Introduction </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">An Award under the Plan can take the form
of: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt"><B>a nil or nominal cost option</B> - which is a right to acquire Shares during the Exercise Period either for
nothing or for the Shares&#8217; nominal value; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt"><B>a conditional award</B> - which is a right to be given Shares automatically on Vesting (or, at the end of the
Holding Period, if the Award is subject to a Holding Period); or </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt"><B>a restricted award</B> - which is an award of Shares, held by or on behalf of the Participant for a period on
the terms of a Restricted Share Agreement, during which time those Shares are forfeitable. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Awards may be subject to: (i)&nbsp;one or
more Performance Conditions; and/or (ii)&nbsp;a post-Vesting Holding Period. Following Vesting or (if applicable) the end of the Holding Period, Awards will be satisfied with &#8220;market purchase&#8221; Shares acquired by the Company&#8217;s
employee benefit trust or, only on or after the Approval Date, by the issue of new Shares or the transfer of Treasury Shares to the Participant. This introduction does not form part of the Plan rules. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Definitions </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In these rules: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Acquiring</B><B> Company&#8221;</B> has the meaning given in rule 8.3.1; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Adoption</B><B> Date&#8221;</B> means the date the Plan is adopted by the Company on the recommendation of the Committee; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Approval</B><B> Date&#8221;</B> means the date the Plan is approved by the Company&#8217;s shareholders; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Award&#8221;</B> means a Conditional Award, an Option or a Restricted Award; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Award</B><B> Certificate&#8221;</B> has the meaning given in rule 1.5.1; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Award</B><B> Date&#8221;</B> means the date which the Committee specifies for the grant of an Award; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Business</B><B> Day&#8221;</B> means a day on which the London Stock Exchange (or, if relevant and if the Committee determines, any other stock
exchange nominated by the Committee on which the Shares are traded) is open for the transaction of business; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Committee&#8221;</B> means,
subject to rule 8.4, the remuneration committee of the board of directors of the Company, or any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-committee</FONT> or person duly authorised by it; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Company&#8221;</B> means Ashtead Group Public Limited Company, a company incorporated in England and Wales with registered number 01807982; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Conditional</B><B> Award&#8221;</B> means a conditional right to automatically acquire Shares granted under the Plan; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Control&#8221;</B> means, in relation to a body corporate, the power of a person to secure by means of the holding of shares or the possession of
voting power in or in relation to that or any other body corporate, </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
or as a result of any powers conferred by the articles of association, or other document regulating that or any other body corporate, that the affairs of the first mentioned body corporate are
conducted in accordance with the wishes of that person; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Dealing</B><B> Restrictions&#8221;</B> means any restrictions relating to dealing in
Shares imposed by law, order, regulation or Government directive or any dealing code adopted by the Company; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Directors&#8217;</B><B>
Remuneration Policy&#8221;</B> means the directors&#8217; remuneration policy within the meaning of section 421(2A) of the Companies Act 2006; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Dividend</B><B> Equivalent Payment&#8221;</B> has the meaning given in rule 4.5; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Exercise</B><B> Period&#8221;</B> means, in relation to an Option, the period beginning on the Expected Release Date or, if there is no Holding
Period, on the Expected Vesting Date and ending on the tenth anniversary of the Award Date (unless the Committee determines a shorter period under rule 1.8.9); </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Expected</B><B> Vesting Date&#8221;</B> means the date specified under rule 1.8.6 on which the Award will normally Vest in accordance with the Plan
rules; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Expected</B><B> Release Date&#8221;</B> means the date specified under rule 1.8.7 on which the Award will normally be Released in
accordance with the Plan rules; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Expiry</B><B> Date&#8221;</B> means 14&nbsp;April 2031, being the tenth anniversary of the Adoption Date; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Group</B><B> Member&#8221;</B> means: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">the Company; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">its Subsidiaries from time to time; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">any other company which is associated with the Company and is so designated by the Committee,
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">and <B>&#8220;Group&#8221;</B> will be construed accordingly; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Holding</B><B> Period&#8221;</B> means a period beginning on the Expected Vesting Date and ending on the Expected Release Date as determined by the
Committee in accordance with rule 1.8.7; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;ITEPA&#8221;</B> means the Income Tax (Earnings and Pensions) Act 2003, as amended from time to time;
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;London</B><B> Stock Exchange&#8221;</B> means the London Stock Exchange plc or any successor entity; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Market</B><B> Value&#8221;</B> means, in relation to a Share on any date: (i)&nbsp;the closing middle-market quotation (taken from the Daily
Official List of the London Stock Exchange) of a Share on the Business Day before the relevant date or (ii)&nbsp;if the Committee so determines, such closing middle-market quotation for any other Business Day (or the average of such closing
middle-market quotations for any Business Days) occurring before the relevant date, as the Committee may determine, provided that such Business Days do not fall within any period when Dealing Restrictions apply to the Participant in respect of the
Award or the Shares subject to the Award; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Official</B><B> List&#8221;</B> means the list maintained by the Financial Conduct Authority for the
purposes of section 74(1) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000; </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Option&#8221;</B> means a right to acquire Shares granted under the Plan in the form of a nil or
nominal cost option; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Option</B><B> Exercise Date&#8221;</B> has the meaning given in rule 4.2.2; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Original</B><B> Entitlements Forfeited&#8221;</B> means, in relation to a Recruitment Award, any awards forfeited by an Eligible Employee as a
result of the Eligible Employee leaving the Eligible Employee&#8217;s former employer; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Participant&#8221;</B> means a person holding an Award
or that person&#8217;s personal representatives (or, in relation to rule 5, a person who has held an Award or that person&#8217;s personal representatives); </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Performance</B><B> Conditions&#8221;</B> means any performance conditions imposed under rule 1.3; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Performance</B><B> Period&#8221;</B> means the period in respect of which the Performance Conditions are to be satisfied as determined by the
Committee in accordance with rule 1.3; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Plan&#8221;</B> means the plan constituted by these rules known as &#8220;The Ashtead Group Long-Term
Incentive Plan 2021&#8221;, as amended from time to time; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;Pro-Rating</FONT></B><B> Period&#8221;</B> means:
</P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Period; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

period beginning on the Award Date and ending on the Expected Vesting Date; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

would have been time <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pro-rated</FONT> in accordance with their terms (had they not lapsed) or such other period as the Committee may determine on or before the Award Date;<B> </B> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Recovery</B><B> Period&#8221;</B> has the meaning given in rule 5.1; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Recruitment</B><B> Award&#8221;</B> means an Award granted in connection with an Eligible Employee&#8217;s recruitment to the Company or one of its
Subsidiaries to compensate the Eligible Employee for any Original Entitlements Forfeited; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Release&#8221;</B> means, in relation to an Award

Restricted Share Agreement, </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">and <B>&#8220;Released&#8221;</B> will be construed accordingly; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Release</B><B> Date&#8221;</B> means the date on which an Award is Released; </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Relevant Employee Share Plan</B>&#8221; means an employee share plan operated by a Group Member
(including the Plan), other than an employee share plan which has been registered with HM Revenue &amp; Customs for the purposes of ITEPA; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Restricted Award</B>&#8221; means an award of Shares under which the beneficial interest in the Shares is held by the Participant subject to the
risk of forfeiture in accordance with these rules; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Restricted Share Agreement</B>&#8221; means an agreement entered into between a Participant
and the Company, which sets out the terms on which the Shares subject to a Restricted Award will be held; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Retained Portion</B>&#8221; means the
percentage of the Shares subject to an Award to be retained during the Holding Period and specified under rule 1.8.7 and, unless the Committee determines otherwise on or before the grant of an Award, the Retained Portion will be 100&nbsp;per cent
or, where any tax or social security contributions arise on the Vesting or exercise of an Award, the Shares remaining (or that would have remained) after the sale of sufficient Shares to meet such tax or social security contributions; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Shares</B>&#8221; means fully paid ordinary shares in the capital of the Company; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Subsidiary</B>&#8221; means a company which is a subsidiary of the Company within the meaning of section 1159 of the Companies Act 2006; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Summary Dismissal</B>&#8221; means, in relation to a Participant, the termination of the Participant&#8217;s employment with a Group Member in
circumstances where that Group Member is entitled to terminate the Participant&#8217;s employment contract summarily without payment; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Treasury
Shares</B>&#8221; has the same meaning as in Chapter 6 of the Companies Act 2006; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Vest</B>&#8221; means: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">if the Award is subject to a Holding Period: </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in respect of a Conditional Award, the Participant becoming entitled, subject to these rules, to receive the
Shares subject to that Conditional Award on the Expected Release Date; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">b)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in respect of an Option, the Participant becoming entitled to exercise that Option during the Exercise Period;
or </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">c)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in respect of a Restricted Award, the Participant&#8217;s Shares ceasing, subject to these rules, to be subject
to the terms of the Restricted Share Agreement on the Expected Release Date; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

construed accordingly; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Vesting Date</B>&#8221; means the date on which an Award Vests. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>
